title: PostDoc in Economics - Behavior of French companies regarding taxes
industry: Economics, Economics and Social Sciences, General Economics (JEL A)
text:
Offer Description
The FIIZU research project (Taxation, Innovation, and Inequalities in Urban Areas) aims to assess the economic resilience of regions in the face of tax reforms (changes to corporate tax, removal of the CVAE, etc.). The project seeks to closely analyze how tax increases and decreases impact company balances depending on their size, sector, and location. In particular, it looks to determine how these transfers are used within companies: do they stimulate local innovation and employment, or do they feed a rent-seeking economy? To do this, the project relies on the use of massive and comprehensive matched microdata (DGFiP, FARE, LIFI, SIRENE) over a long period (2010–2023) housed on the CASD's secure server, and uses causal inference and advanced classification methods to identify behavioral signatures of entrepreneurs.
